name: ARGUS · alert flow report
description: Manual report over argus_alert_flow for hardware sizing: totals, suppression, LLM load, latency p95, peak per hour / 5 min, hourly series, top agents and rules. Window set in 'Report Window' (hours).

parameters.query:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT * FROM argus_alert_flow
  WHERE source NOT IN ('manual', 'test') AND ts > now() - make_interval(hours => $1::int)
)
SELECT
  $1::int AS window_hours,
  (SELECT to_char(min(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI "UTC"') FROM f) AS first_event_utc,
  (SELECT to_char(max(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI "UTC"') FROM f) AS last_event_utc,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE stage = 'received') AS received,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE stage = 'received' AND level >= 12) AS received_level_12_plus,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE stage = 'suppressed') AS suppressed_repeats,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE stage = 'forwarded') AS forwarded_to_llm,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE stage = 'analyzed' AND llm_ok) AS llm_ok,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM f WHERE stage = 'analyzed' AND NOT llm_ok) AS llm_failed,
  (SELECT round(avg(llm_latency_s)::numeric, 1) FROM f WHERE stage = 'analyzed') AS llm_latency_avg_s,
  (SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY llm_latency_s))::numeric, 1) FROM f WHERE stage = 'analyzed') AS llm_latency_p95_s,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT agent_name) FROM f WHERE stage = 'received') AS agents_seen,
  (SELECT max(c) FROM (SELECT count(*) c FROM f WHERE stage = 'received' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', ts)) x) AS peak_received_per_hour,
  (SELECT max(c) FROM (SELECT count(*) c FROM f WHERE stage = 'forwarded' GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', ts)) x) AS peak_llm_per_hour,
  (SELECT max(c) FROM (SELECT count(*) c FROM f WHERE stage = 'forwarded' GROUP BY to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch FROM ts) / 300) * 300)) x) AS peak_llm_per_5min,
  (SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY t.hour_utc) FROM (
     SELECT to_char(date_trunc('hour', ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00 "UTC"') AS hour_utc,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'received') AS received,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'forwarded') AS to_llm
     FROM f GROUP BY 1) t) AS hourly,
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (
     SELECT agent_name, count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'received') AS received,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'forwarded') AS to_llm
     FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) t) AS top_agents,
  (SELECT json_agg(t) FROM (
     SELECT rule_id, max(rule_description) AS description, max(level) AS level,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'received') AS received,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'forwarded') AS to_llm
     FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10) t) AS top_rules;
